notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Update 1.91 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Hunters and Ghosts![/h2]

This patch marks a special milestone for Hunt Together – our first anniversary! 🎉

We want to extend a heartfelt [b]THANK YOU[/b] to our incredible community for an amazing year filled with unforgettable moments, valuable feedback, and unwavering support. This journey wouldn’t have been possible without you, and we’re excited to continue growing and evolving together. Here’s what’s in store for you in this celebratory update:

[h3]3 New Cards:[/h3] Unlock powerful abilities and strategies with our latest additions for Levels 14, 15, and 16 – The Sun, The Ram, and The Holy King!

[h3]Anniversary Event:[/h3] Celebrate with us! Join the festivities and participate in special challenges and rewards! You can find more information in-game or on our Discord channel: https://discord.com/invite/becomeawizard 🙂

[h3]Achievements Now Live:[/h3] Track your progress and show off your skills with new achievements, available on Quest, Rift, and Steam platforms!

[h3]Card Tweaks & Balancing:[/h3] Some cards have been rebalanced to ensure a better experience – Sixth Sense and The Vampire are now more powerful! Additionally, Hunters must now hit barricaded doors 4 times to break them (but watch out for a new card that can help reduce that number aka: The Ram!).

Dive in and explore all the new content—we can’t wait to see you in action! Remember that we recently added the [b]Solo Waiting Mode[/b] where you can play solo until the game finds you a match - this should keep you entertained while you await your next opponent!

Thank you for an incredible year, and here’s to many more adventures ahead! Let us know your thoughts on the newest update!

[h3]Happy Hunting![/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.9 Now Live + Solo Mode!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Hunters and Ghosts![/h2]

We hope you are having a great start in the New Year 2025! We’re excited to share the latest patch notes for Hunt Together which introduces new features and improvements designed to enhance your gameplay experience, with the addition of the long awaited Solo Waiting Mode! Let’s dive in:

[h3]🎮 Solo Waiting Mode[/h3]
- We heard you Community! By popular request, we’ve introduced Solo Waiting Mode on Train Chase, Laboratory, and Arcade maps. Now, you can play solo while the matchmaking system finds you a challenging opponent. No more waiting around—dive straight into the action (and let us know your thoughts on this newest addition to the game)!

[h3]📢 New Announcer System[/h3]
- Immerse yourself further with our new in-game announcer! The announcer will comment on key moments like Round Start, Ghost Wins, Hunter Wins, and many more, keeping you updated and engaged throughout the match. Listen and you shall be informed! 

[h3]⚖️ Balance Tweaks[/h3]
- Round time reduced by 10% for faster, more dynamic matches!
- Additional minor adjustments to ensure a more balanced and enjoyable experience.
- Small bug fixes.

[h3]❤️ Thank You Community![/h3]
Your support means everything to us! We hope this update makes your Hunt Together experience even more enjoyable. Keep sharing your feedback—it helps us make the game even better. From all of us on the team, thank you for playing, and we can’t wait to see you hunt in the latest update! 

[h3]Happy Hunting![/h3]

notes.title: Hunt Together - Update 1.6 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We’ve been working hard to bring you a bone-chilling new update for Hunt Together, packed with exciting tools, a haunting new map, and smoother gameplay to make your hunting experience even more thrilling! Get ready for the fog to roll in—here’s what’s new!

Please take a look at our Roadmap of what’s coming next for Hunt Together (along with its [b]Quest+[/b] launch!) 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779846/cf70cb5a29ff46037e1b6108b512488e67a478ec.png[/img]
[h2]Welcome Quest+ Update Video:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=hH6kv8JV2ns;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]New Tool: Rebound Hourglass – Catch me if you can! ⌛[/h3]
Feeling sneaky? The Hourglass is about to become your best friend (and your opponent's worst nightmare). This crafty teleportation device allows you to place your phantom-clone at any location and, when the time is right, poof—you’re back in that exact spot!
Perfect for those “Houdini moments” when you need a quick escape or a slick tactical retreat.

[h3]New Tool: Echo Shield – Defend Against the Ghosts! 🛡️[/h3]
Worried about that spooky Ghost jumpscaring you so often? No worries, because the Ghost Shield is here to protect you! Just whip out the Ghost Shield to push back any spectre getting too close for comfort. The shield doesn’t just defend—it creates space for you to strategize and counterattack, giving you a supernatural edge in the most intense moments of gameplay. Ghost-proof your battle plan!

[h3]Cemetery Level for Elimination Mode – Who Will Rest in Peace? ⚰️[/h3]
Time for a new map! Enter the Cemetery—a foggy, spine-tingling graveyard that’s perfect for some intense Elimination Mode showdowns. Whether you prefer stalking your enemies from the shadows of crypts or charging through the open tombstone-strewn grounds, this map has something for every type of player.
With hidden pathways, eerie fog, and hair-raising moments around every corner, the Cemetery is designed to keep you on your toes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779846/714df7e6d6eb5ee6c9826df485ff3748309580cd.png[/img]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements – Smoother Scares Ahead! 🛠️[/h3]
Along with the new tools and levels, we’ve squashed some minor bugs and improved overall gameplay to ensure everything runs smoother than a ghost gliding through walls. You’ll notice enhanced performance, snappier controls, and an overall creepier (in the best way) experience.

So grab your Hourglass, equip that Ghost Shield, and get ready to battle it out in the foggy, spooky Cemetery. This update is packed with surprises, and we hope you enjoy your new hunting experience!

If you have any questions or just want to meet up with other fellow Hunters feel free to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/becomeawizard


[h3]Happy Hunting![/h3]

notes.title: Hunt Together - Update 1.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Update 1.1 Now Live![/h2]

Hello, ghosts and hunters! 

Patch 1.1 introduces new features, changes, and fixes. We've listened to your feedback, and this patch includes many changes based on your suggestions. 

We're confident that you'll enjoy your spooky adventures even more now.

[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Voice Chat - get ready to scare your friends in more ways!
[*] Separate option movement ghost and hunter - you can now customize your playing experience by changing the movement type for each character.
[*] Better graphics on PC
[*] Coins - collect them on maps to earn a bit more money.
[*] Discs can block spirit lockbox beam - discs are no longer only for filling obelisks; now, you can use them to temporarily block the beam from the spirit lockbox.
[*] Online Services - check the color of the bar to find out if there are any issues with the servers.
[*] Last status - we've moved the information from the quick game button and improved it. Now, when someone leaves, loses internet connection, or encounters other issues, you will be informed about it.
[*] Tips - find Tips at the bottom of the Main Menu or in both Hide-and-seek and Elimination lobbies.
[*] Gramophone - wanted to have a party with your fellow ghosts? Fear no more - we've added a Gramophone in both lobbies with interchangeable vinyls. (P.S. Look for special vinyl with great party music.)
[*] Lobby ID - is now visible to both ghosts and hunters!
[*] Objective button - after completing the tutorial for the first time, in your first real game you must press the objective button for objectives to disappear. Worry not, this is a ONE-TIME ONLY requirement!
[*] Pickups in lobby - we’ve added a few things to play around with in the lobby. Check them out!
[*] Someone joined? - if anyone joins your lobby, you will be notified by a delicate swoosh sound.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New sections and upgraded tutorial - We recommend checking it out!
[*] Private matchmaking is much clearer now.
[*] Telekinesis objects can now be used many times + added 20 seconds of cooldown.
[*] More telekinesis objects.
[*] In Hide and Seek - Ghosts can now leave mid-game without destroying the whole session. If all of the ghosts leave, the Hunter wins the game and is provided with an exp and gold bonus.
[*] Added the “Are you sure?” button before leaving the lobby.
[*] Changed “HUB” to “Wardrobe”.
[*] Upgraded Main Menu for a smoother experience.
[*] Upgraded text readability.
[*] MORE EXP AND GOLD FOR EVERYTHING!
[*] Upgraded hunter tool belt snapping.
[*] Upgraded visibility on hands of how much energy the ghost has.
[*] Changed card description - now everything should be clear.
[*] Added a threshold on the knob so using the interaction rod feels better.
[*] Electric shock sparks are larger by 50%.
[*] The slider for scrolling skins is now larger.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed disks holding after getting trapped in Ghost Pawn trap.
[*] Fixed collisions for hunter tools.
[*] Ghost whispers are now more audible.
[*] Hide and Seek spectators cannot fill obelisks.
[*] If the ghost is hit with a banishing talisman, he loses a bit of energy gathered.
[*] Fixed joining in the middle of Hide-and-Seek games.
[*] Blackout is no longer so aggressive.
[*] Fixed stacking of cards in one slot.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Occasionally, even with voice chat disabled, players may still hear others while remaining unheard themselves. [b]Workaround:[/b] Enable and then disable voice chat once more. We are diligently searching for a permanent solution to this issue.
[/list]

We ensure that we constantly review your reports, opinions, and feedback. If you have encountered any problems or have ideas on how to enrich Hunt Together with new and interesting content, please let us know. 😉 Feel free to share your thoughts on our game via the Discord server or in the Steam Discussions!

Thank you, everyone, and have a great week!

Stay up to date!

[h3]Happy Hunting! [/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778030/Hunt_Together/


[b]Our Social Media channels[/b]

notes.title: Hunt Together - the Open Beta summary is here 📜
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you for participating in the Beta, everyone! 🤝[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In recent weeks, the abandoned, spooky Mansion has been filled with [b]dozens of[/b] cunning, frightening [b]Ghosts [/b]and fearless [b]Hunters [/b]struggling to get rid of unwanted tenants. Corridors, chambers, hallways, and other various rooms echoed with the intensity of fierce duels, featuring the utilization of [b]numerous mystical items and unique skills. [/b]

It so happens that we have been watching all of your struggles and listening carefully to all of your [b]reports and opinions.[/b] Thanks to your incredible enthusiasm and willingness to help us further upgrade our game, we managed to collect [b]a lot of interesting data[/b]... and today we want to share it with you!

Since the Beta is now officially closed, it's time for the summary! Below you will find some of the most interesting statistics that you shared with us via our Discord server and Beta Feedback Form...


[h2]Let's take a look at the summary 👀 (click for a better view)[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779846/5bd86e7bf901eb2cadcaaf4308d62a675d730c70.png[/img]


[h2]The release date is just around the corner 🥳[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[b]January 25th[/b] (being the release date of the game on the Meta Quest Store) and [b]February 2024[/b] (for PCVR) are really, really close! And believe us - we are just as excited as you are, Ghosts and Hunters! We are extremely curious how you will make use of the opportunities presented by the new maps. We also want to see what strategies you will choose in Hide and Seek mode, where you will be able to feel the thrill of 1v3 matches. Not to mention the numerous [b]character skins[/b] we have prepared for you!

Our entire team is very grateful to all those who decided to take part in the Beta and provided us with their feedback - you have all proven once again how great testers you are! We believe that thanks to your help, Hunt Together has become even more immersive and fun to play. We really appreciate it!

As always, we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions. We are always [b]happy to hear from you[/b], so be sure to share your thoughts and ideas whenever you feel like it 😁 See you on January 25, everyone!

notes.title: Hunt Together - a PVP VR Horror game coming to PCVR
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready, as things are about to get really spooky! [/h2]

Let's start with some good news and dates, shall we? The Meta Quest version of the game will arrive on [b]Jan 25th[/b], with the PCVR version following shortly after. But there's more - in about two weeks you will be able to see for yourself what a fantastic and spooky adventure awaits you because... Meta Quest x PCVR [b]Hunt Together Beta will kick off on Dec 19th! [/b]- more info on this topic can be found on our [url=https://discord.gg/becomeawizard]Discord [/url]server.


[h2]➡️ And now, let us tell you something about the game itself ⬅️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Hunt Together is a multiplayer VR game offering two [b]Player vs Player modes,[/b] in which you take on the role of the bold Hunter or the terrifying Ghost. Your task will be to defeat your opponent with the help of numerous skills, items and usable environmental elements. The arenas of your battles are spooky, chilling locations, such as an abandoned mine, a haunted mansion or a forgotten orphanage 😱 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779846/0ea323b87b99c76eced09f08ccd2effda5e33087.png[/img]


In addition to being able to face your friends in the [b]Elimination Mode (1v1) or the Hide and Seek Mode (1v3)[/b], you also can acquire new skins for your favorite characters and develop their skills through a progression system. 

We are sure you have a lot of questions, and we will be happy to answer them all. Be sure to follow our Social Media channels and join our [url=https://discord.gg/becomeawizard]Discord[/url]!


[h2]😱 It's all about competition... and giving your friends a good scare! 😁 [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We can't wait for you to get lost among dark corridors, rocky tunnels, countless rooms in abandoned mansions, and... toilets, and find out how you will cope with the task of defeating your opponent. Will you be able to put all of the Ghost's amazing abilities to good use? Can you complete numerous rituals as a Hunter and efficiently use the arsenal of unique items at your disposal? And finally - will you be brave enough to try it again, again... and again? Well 😁 there is only one way to find out! See you soon in the Beta, everyone!
